## BigDecimal

9-digit operands, precision 28. libmpdec is the C library behind
CPython's `decimal`, timed without the interpreter.

| Operation | decimo | libmpdec | vs libmpdec | CPython `decimal` | vs CPython |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| add | 43.8 ns | 37.0 ns | 1.18× slower | 48.7 ns | **1.11× faster** |
| subtract | 47.6 ns | 36.1 ns | 1.32× slower | 50.4 ns | **1.06× faster** |
| multiply | 42.6 ns | 29.0 ns | 1.47× slower | 42.7 ns | parity |
| divide | 151.6 ns | 49.9 ns | 3.04× slower | 66.6 ns | 2.28× slower |
| round | 42.0 ns | 35.2 ns | 1.19× slower | 71.9 ns | **1.71× faster** |
| parse | 97.6 ns | 40.8 ns | 2.39× slower | 83.0 ns | 1.18× slower |

In place, where neither side allocates a result:

| | decimo | libmpdec | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `x += y` | 6.1 ns | 9.0 ns | **1.49× faster** |
| `x -= y` | 44.7 ns | 9.3 ns | 4.81× slower |
| `x *= y` | 54.6 ns | 23.3 ns | 2.34× slower |

## sqrt, exp, ln, power

A fixed set, chosen before the results were seen, at three
precisions. `2.3456789`, and `**1.5` for power.

| Precision | operation | decimo | libmpdec | |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 28 | sqrt | 2.58 µs | 836.0 ns | 3.09× slower |
| 28 | exp | 4.27 µs | 4.27 µs | parity |
| 28 | ln | 4.59 µs | 12.31 µs | **2.68× faster** |
| 28 | power | 11.05 µs | 34.25 µs | **3.10× faster** |
| 100 | sqrt | 4.38 µs | 4.10 µs | 1.07× slower |
| 100 | exp | 10.19 µs | 14.47 µs | **1.42× faster** |
| 100 | ln | 69.52 µs | 37.66 µs | 1.85× slower |
| 100 | power | 89.93 µs | 77.61 µs | 1.16× slower |
| 1,000 | sqrt | 51.88 µs | 226.56 µs | **4.37× faster** |
| 1,000 | exp | 387.06 µs | 4.71 ms | **12.17× faster** |
| 1,000 | ln | 2.83 ms | 5.91 ms | **2.09× faster** |
| 1,000 | power | 3.27 ms | 11.64 ms | **3.56× faster** |

## BigDecimal across operand sizes

Operand digits, not precision. Add and multiply are **exact** on both
sides (decimo `precision=0`, libmpdec `mpd_maxcontext`); divide targets
operand width + 8 digits on both. decimo's time, then how it compares.

Verified this run: both libraries produce the same 2000-digit
product from the 1000-digit operands.

| Digits | add | | multiply | | divide | |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 9 | 40.6 ns | 1.31× slower | 42.4 ns | 1.37× slower | 143.7 ns | 2.87× slower |
| 100 | 44.4 ns | **1.36× faster** | 113.8 ns | **1.31× faster** | 1.27 µs | 3.65× slower |
| 1,000 | 110.0 ns | parity | 2.58 µs | **3.80× faster** | 27.13 µs | 1.90× slower |
| 10,000 | 795.0 ns | 1.24× slower | 128.10 µs | **2.85× faster** | 550.88 µs | **2.26× faster** |
| 100,000 | 7.55 µs | 1.25× slower | 2.45 ms | **1.15× faster** | 13.22 ms | parity |

## BigInt against CPython's int

CPython's integers can only be reached through the interpreter, so
these include its overhead — read the large sizes as the real ones.

| Digits | decimo add | CPython add | | decimo multiply | CPython multiply | |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 100 | 42.0 ns | 24.0 ns | 1.75× slower | 85.5 ns | 97.6 ns | **1.14× faster** |
| 1,000 | 52.2 ns | 89.6 ns | **1.72× faster** | 1.13 µs | 5.38 µs | **4.78× faster** |
| 10,000 | 270.0 ns | 784.1 ns | **2.90× faster** | 52.26 µs | 260.32 µs | **4.98× faster** |
| 100,000 | 2.38 µs | 7.71 µs | **3.24× faster** | 1.18 ms | 8.64 ms | **7.33× faster** |

## pi()

Each measurement in a fresh process, since mpmath and MPFR cache the
constant. Includes conversion to a decimal string, for every library.

| Digits | decimo | mpmath + GMP | MPFR | mpmath (pure Python) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 100 | 8.24 µs | 42.46 µs | 40.58 µs | 33.38 µs |
| 1,000 | 66.43 µs | 105.33 µs | 65.38 µs | 164.46 µs |
| 10,000 | 1.29 ms | 848.12 µs | 672.04 µs | 5.69 ms |
| 100,000 | 33.85 ms | 15.08 ms | 22.50 ms | 180.96 ms |
| 1,000,000 | 814.34 ms | 260.73 ms | 417.52 ms | 8.272 s |
